content.short: Beamer enables users to move tokens between rollups without routing through layer 1 chains.
content.description: Beamer enables transferring tokens across EVM-compatible rollups quickly and securely. Transfers can complete in as little as 2.5 seconds, with exact amounts delivered every time. A 0.3% upfront fee is charged on the source rollup. The system also lets users access decentralized applications and consolidate assets on the rollup they choose. Beamer is community-driven, open source, and designed to prioritize user experience while maintaining strong security.
content.meta: Beamer enables users to move tokens between EVM-compatible rollups with speed and security. Discover Beamer and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
